newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian Nov house material prices rise.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian Nov house material prices rise.

text.p: Australian house building materials prices rose 0.1 percent in November from the previous month and were 0.2 percent higher than a year earlier, the Australian Bureau of Statistics said on Friday.
Other building materials prices fell 0.1 percent in November and were unchanged from a year before.
The bureau said the monthly rise in housing materials price index was fuelled by an increase in prices for clay bricks.

The small fall in the non-housing materials index was mainly due to decreases in prices for elevators and escalators and mains cable, partly offset by an increase in prices for structural steel, the bureau said.
